digest.component_or_area: reconciler apply and child process runtime
propositions: Write/apply and subprocess paths rebuild config or reuse broad parent environments instead of scoped S2 runtime, allowing unintended scope writes and credential leaks
Jira Cloud scope has implicit DIG fallbacks in write path, live access-check probe, runtime default, and create-time default that can execute requests under unintended scope
Child process environment receives ambient inheritance and global adapter overlays without isolation, causing unrelated siblings to access secrets declared by other Rebar adapters
Environment projection API and adapter secret name registry do not exist to selectively project environment variables and prevent cross-adapter credential visibility
Every implicit DIG Jira-project default in resolve_jira_settings, access_check, runtime constants, and project ensures must fail closed when scope is unset rather than defaulting to DIG
